description: Post-hoc re-run of llm_test_full_gemma3-4b under rule set v1.2 (spot drilling is preparatory, so a spot-drill-only hole is a coverage violation) with best-candidate selection in the loop. The initial plans are replayed from the v1.1 run, so only validation and repair differ. The flaw was found on the test split, so report this next to the v1.1 run, never in place of it.
